_meta.source: hand-written questions from the FIRST CVSS v3.1 specification

av.question: Does exploitation require the attacker to physically touch or manipulate the device?
av.label: P

av.question: Is the attack limited to the same local / radio network segment (logically adjacent)?
av.label: A

av.question: Does the attacker need local access (a local account, a shell, or a user opening a file)?
av.label: L

av.question: Otherwise: can it be exploited remotely over a network or the internet?
av.label: N

ac.question: Does success depend on conditions beyond the attacker's control (race, man-in-the-middle, special configuration, information gathering)?
ac.label: H

ac.question: Otherwise: can the attack be repeated at will with no special conditions?
ac.label: L

pr.question: Must the attacker already hold administrative / high privileges?
pr.label: H

pr.question: Must the attacker be an ordinary authenticated / logged-in user?
pr.label: L

pr.question: Otherwise: can an anonymous, unauthenticated attacker do it?
pr.label: N

ui.question: Must a user other than the attacker take some action (click, open, visit)?
ui.label: R

ui.question: Otherwise: can it be exploited without any action from another user?
ui.label: N

s.question: Can the impact cross a security boundary into another component (sandbox/VM/container escape, script running in other users' browsers, SSRF)?
s.label: C

s.question: Otherwise: does the impact stay inside the vulnerable component?
s.label: U

cues.cue: in the context of the current user

c.question: Can the attacker read all / any restricted data (total loss of confidentiality)?
c.label: H

c.question: Can the attacker read only some restricted data, without control over what?
c.label: L

c.question: Otherwise: is there no confidentiality impact (e.g. pure availability bug)?
c.label: N

i.question: Can the attacker modify any / all data or run code (total loss of integrity)?
i.label: H

i.question: Can the attacker modify only some data, with limited consequence?
i.label: L

i.question: Otherwise: is there no integrity impact (read-only or availability-only bug)?
i.label: N

a.question: Can the attacker fully deny access to the component (crash, hang, exhaustion)?
a.label: H

a.question: Is availability only reduced or interrupted partially?
a.label: L

a.question: Otherwise: is there no availability impact (read / modify data only)?
a.label: N
